title: “I Hadn’t Thought About That”: Creators of Human-like AI Weigh in on Ethics & Neurodivergence

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative study using interpretative phenomenological analysis (IPA) of semi-structured interviews and surveys with AI creators to examine their design choices, conceptualizations of 'humanness', accessibility considerations, and reactions to scenario-based questions involving neurodivergent traits and behaviors.
Interviews and surveys assessing AI developers' considerations (or lack thereof) for physical and cognitive accessibility needs when designing human-like AI systems.
